eras.title: Egypt, the Exodus and the Wilderness

events.title: God decides to destroy every living thing
Birth of Shem
events.notes: Not all of Noah's sons listed in Gen 5:32 would have been born the same year. Shem was born when Noah was 102 in light of Gen 11:12.

events.title: God instructs Noah to build the ark
God makes a covenant with Noah
Noah gets drunk and Canaan is cursed
Birth of Abraham
events.notes: Not all of Terah's sons would have been born the same year. In light of Acts 7:4 and Genesis 12:4, Abraham was born when Terah was 130 years old.

events.title: Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin
Babylonian Captivity
events.notes: 70 years of servitude to Babylon (Jer 25:11, 29:10), counted by Jones/Ussher from the first deportation in Jehoiakim's 3rd year (606 BC) to Cyrus's decree (536 BC).

events.title: Reign of Nebuchadnezzar
events.notes: Counted from his accession year, 605 BC (Jer 25:1: Jehoiakim's 4th = Nebuchadnezzar's 1st). 43 years.

events.title: Daniel interprets Nebuchadnezzar's dream
events.notes: Dan 2:1 says the second year; Jones dates the dream to 604 BC, Nebuchadnezzar's first official year.

events.title: Chaldean raiders take captives from Judah
Death of Jehoiakim
events.notes: Jehoiakim died in Dec. 598 BC during Nebuchadnezzar's siege (Jones); Jeremiah foretold he would have 'the burial of an ass'.

events.title: The glory of the LORD leaves the Temple
Gedaliah is made governor
events.notes: After the fall of Jerusalem, Nebuchadnezzar made Gedaliah son of Ahikam governor over the people left in Judah, at Mizpah.

events.title: Ishmael kills Gedaliah
events.notes: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, sent by Baalis king of the Ammonites, murdered Gedaliah at Mizpah in the seventh month.

events.title: The remnant flees to Egypt
events.notes: Fearing Babylon after Gedaliah's murder, Johanan led the remnant of Judah to Egypt against the word of the LORD, taking Jeremiah and Baruch with them.

events.title: Daniel in the lions' den
events.notes: Daniel was cast into the den of lions for praying to his God against Darius's decree, and God shut the lions' mouths.

events.title: Return from Exile
events.notes: From Cyrus's decree and the first return (536 BC) to the close of the Old Testament record (Nehemiah's second term, Malachi).

events.title: Cyrus decrees the rebuilding of the Temple
The altar is rebuilt
events.notes: In the seventh month after the return, Jeshua and Zerubbabel built the altar and restored the burnt offerings and the feast of tabernacles, before the Temple foundation was laid.

events.title: Ezra reads the Law
events.notes: Ezra read the book of the Law to the assembly in the seventh month; the people kept the feast of tabernacles, confessed their sins and sealed a covenant under Nehemiah the Tirshatha.

events.title: Reign of Darius (Ahasuerus)
events.notes: Darius I Hystaspis, counted from his first year (521 BC). Jones and Ussher identify him with the Ahasuerus of Esther.

events.title: Ahasuerus feasts and Vashti is deposed
Mordecai uncovers a plot against the king
events.notes: Mordecai learned of a plot by Bigthan and Teresh to kill King Ahasuerus and told Esther; the plot was recorded in the chronicles.

events.title: Haman plots to destroy the Jews
Esther goes before the king
events.notes: On the third day of the fast Esther went in to the king unbidden; he held out the sceptre, and she invited him and Haman to a banquet.

events.title: Ahasuerus honors Mordecai
events.notes: Nisan 510 BC, the same Nisan as Haman's decree (Esth 3:12), per Jones's Chart 5; his Appendix F prints 509 BC.

events.title: The Jews defeat their enemies
events.notes: Adar of Darius's 12th year, which falls in 509 BC (Jones).

events.title: Reign of Artaxerxes
events.notes: Artaxerxes I Longimanus, counted from 473 BC when Xerxes made him pro-rex (Ussher, Jones).

events.title: Exiles put away their foreign wives
Nehemiah mourns for Jerusalem
events.notes: Chislev of the 20th year falls before the Nisan of Neh 2:1, so Jones dates it to 455 BC.

events.title: Artaxerxes sends Nehemiah to Jerusalem
events.notes: Jones starts Daniel's 70 weeks (Dan 9:25) from this decree.

events.title: Nehemiah rebuilds the wall of Jerusalem
Nehemiah's reforms
events.notes: Returning from the king, Nehemiah threw Tobiah out of the Temple chamber, restored the Levites' portions, enforced the Sabbath and dealt with the foreign marriages.

events.title: An Angel Speaks to Joseph in a Dream
Joseph and Mary Flee to Egypt
Joseph and Mary return from Egypt
Joseph and Mary return to Nazareth
Jesus as a child in the Temple
Peter's Mother-in-law and Others Healed
people: Mother of the Wife of Simon

events.title: Jesus' Message on John the Baptist
Blind and Dumb Demoniac and Following Discourse
Healing a Boy with a Demon
Second Foretelling of Death and Resurrection
Tax Coin in a Fish's Mouth
Healing a Crowd near Sea of Galilee
Healing a Blind Man at Bethsaida
Light of the World/I am discourse
Feast of Dedication
events.notes: Kislev 25, Mon Dec 17th 29 AD

events.title: Lepers Healed
events.notes: Between Samaria and Galilee in an unnamed village

events.title: Discourse on the Kingdom and Other Parables
Zacchaeus Converted and Parable of the Pounds
Teaching and Healing in Perea to Jerusalem
events.notes: Perea, not listed in place table

events.title: Ananias and Sapphira lie to God
Apostles work signs and wonders in Solomon's Portico
Gamaliel advises the council and Apostles freed
Peter preaches to gentiles in Caesarea
An angel rescues Peter from prison
Barnabas and Saul go to Cyprus
Mission to Phrygia, Galatia and Asia
Paul casts demon out of soothsayer
Paul is shipwrecked by a storm
